articles.title: Infopark focuses to be south India’s GCC hub
articles.description: Infopark Kerala targets Kochi as South India’s GCC hub, boosting R&D and innovation; draft policy aims for 120 GCCs and 1.6 lakh jobs in five years.

articles.title: Artists relive Awadh’s musical legacy in Canada
articles.description: Awadh’s musical legacy celebrated in British Columbia as Aadaab Arz Lucknow hosts a cultural evening with ghazals, tributes, and Lucknowi cuisine.

articles.title: Chilli fumes spark panic as fire guts cold storage
articles.description: Massive fire at Himalayan Cold Storage in Lucknow’s Chinhat triggered chilli fumes, evacuated 50 homes, and took 8 hours to control; no casualties reported.

articles.description: Kochi’s Paliyam Thuruth–Kadamakkudy bridge gets final alignment approval, clearing Water Metro land hurdle and advancing Moolampilly–Chathanad link.

articles.description: AIIMS Bhopal will host an ATLS Provider Course July 30–Aug 1 to train doctors in rapid trauma assessment and life-saving emergency care for injury patients.

articles.description: Bhopal’s Gitanjali Complex to get ₹40 lakh AMRUT 2.0-linked road reconstruction and Rabindranath Tagore Garden upgrades including open gym, yoga zone and track.
